issuer: Advisory Committee of the Supreme Court of Missouri / Office of Legal Ethics Counsel
title: Missouri Informal Ethics Opinion 930081
text: QUESTION: Wife and Husband 1 had Child A. After divorce, Wife had custody of Child A. Wife remarried and Attorney´s firm represented Wife in case involving custody of Child B. May attorney now represent Husband 1 in custody case involving Child A? ANSWER: No, unless Wife gives a knowing and intelligent waiver of the conflict.
